prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. MEDIUM reference: an elegant observational picture-book drawing with a clear coherent silhouette, 6–10 separated distinguishing structural details and natural joined parts. Richer form than an icon, without intricate texture or dense repeated marks. One sea turtle in a gentle top three-quarter view with large graceful front flippers, smaller rear flippers and six broad shell plates, no sea scene.
Clean black contour drawing with smooth blank interiors. Natural coherent structure, but no dense repeated texture, no shading or gray tonal fills. Keep the complete silhouette inside the canvas with clear margins.
